IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_SidebarTooltip: Last Seen Where: find an item you have seen
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Hint: Type the name of an item you have seen.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_NothingRemembered: You do not remember seeing that.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_NotInBuilding: You are not in a building.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_ServerBusy: Server busy, results will be slower
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_SeeAll_tooltip: Your searches also show what other players marked private.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_MarkMe_tooltip: You keep this to yourself: what you saw of it is left out of other players' searches. If a faction or safehouse member finds it, they will mention it, and you will see who. Anyone who finds it shares it with their own people as usual.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_MarkGroup_tooltip: What you saw of this is shared only with your faction and safehouse members. Anyone who sees it for themselves remembers and shares it as usual.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Unmark_tooltip: Remove the mark: this shows in searches again like anything else.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_NoPlaces: You do not remember any containers.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_NothingNear: Nothing on you or in the open loot window matches.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Refused_full: Too many private marks. Share some first.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Refused_unknown: You no longer remember that, or it is out of reach.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Refused_busy: Still remembering, try again in a moment.
IGUI_TienLastSeenWhere_Refused_off: Privacy is turned off on this server.
